messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Reached max evaluation using SPDE
parts:
Hi,

I can't tell what the error messages at the end mean, but it does look like your starting values for theta1 and theta2 (and likely your priors) for the SPDE model are quite extreme, and the optimization is moving the model towards kappa=0, which is an intrinsic model, and that is probably not what you wanted.  The default priors are not necessarily sensible, so please take a look for one way of setting more sensible SPDE parameter priorsint the tutorial at
Http://people.bath.ac.uk/fl353/isba/

Finn
